humanityNarrative.heading: From Los Angeles to Cupertino, and interests beyond dentistry
humanityNarrative.text: Infantino Dental’s undated “Meet the Doctor” biography says Nick Infantino grew up in Los Angeles, earned a biological-science bachelor’s degree at Loyola Marymount University in 1978, and earned a DDS at Loyola University’s College of Dental Surgery in 1983. It says he completed a residency at the Veteran’s Hospital and worked in private practice for two years before moving to Cupertino and opening a general-dentistry practice in 1985. The same biography says he enjoys mountain biking, riding motorcycles, and spending time in the mountains with family and close friends. These are the practice’s source-stated career and interest details, not independent credential verification or evidence of care quality or outcomes.

patientAccess.text: The named practice page lists 10363 Torre Ave F, Cupertino, CA 95014; (408) 252-8156; a request-an-appointment link; and weekday hours of Monday–Tuesday 8 a.m.–5 p.m., Wednesday 8 a.m.–3 p.m., and Thursday 8 a.m.–5 p.m., with Friday–Sunday closed. It says the practice accepts “most dental insurance plans” and asks patients to contact the office about a specific plan. This does not confirm a particular member, plan, service or benefit. Fees, referral requirements and current appointment capacity are not established by the page.
